ideas.title: Number and algebraic foundations
ideas.mechanism: Number forms and algebraic rearrangement are the language of later topics.

ideas.title: Functions, equations and graphs
ideas.mechanism: A function maps inputs to outputs; equations are solved; graphs display the mapping.

ideas.title: Geometry, measure and trigonometry
ideas.mechanism: Shape, angle, length and trig ratios describe plane and solid figures.

ideas.title: Calculus
ideas.mechanism: Derivative is instantaneous rate; integral accumulates; they invert.

ideas.title: Vectors, matrices and transformations
ideas.mechanism: Linear maps act on geometric objects via vectors, matrices and named transformations.

ideas.title: Probability
ideas.mechanism: Events are subsets of a sample space; independence and conditionals multiply/add correctly.

ideas.title: Statistics and data handling
ideas.mechanism: Summaries (mean, spread, cumulative frequency) describe a data set without claiming a probability model.

ideas.title: Discrete maths: sequences, counting and proof
ideas.mechanism: Discrete structure (nth term, counting, proof) is not continuous calculus or data summary.

ideas.title: Exponentials and logarithms
ideas.mechanism: Log is inverse of exponential; indices become sums.

ideas.title: Trigonometric functions and identities
ideas.mechanism: Sine/cosine as functions of angle, not just right-triangle ratios in a bearing diagram.

ideas.title: Differentiation
ideas.mechanism: dy/dx is the local linear rate; stationary points from vanishing derivative.

ideas.title: Integration
ideas.mechanism: Antiderivative / definite integral accumulates area or inverts differentiation.

ideas.title: Matrices and determinants
ideas.mechanism: Matrix algebra (inverse, product, eigenvalues) is not the same as describing a reflection.

ideas.title: Permutations and combinations
ideas.mechanism: Ordered arrangements vs unordered selections; not P(event) unless a probability is asked.

ideas.title: Mechanics applications
ideas.mechanism: Particles, forces and projectiles use math:M1–M4 as a modelling context (9709/9231/0606 kinematics).

ideas.title: Finance and proportional change
ideas.mechanism: Money, interest and proportion are number-in-context, not a new algebraic object.

ideas.title: Modelling and real-world problem solving
ideas.mechanism: Timetables, travel graphs and measurement contexts apply school maths beside the pure spine.
